faq.question: Is there an entry fee for a meetup?
faq.answer: GameHub is a computer club with a hourly fee (around 500 ֏ per hour)

faq.question: What if I've never played fighting games before?
faq.answer: Show up anyway. The community will help you to learn

faq.question: On what platform do you play?
What games are available?
faq.answer: Pretty much everything you'd want. We have dozens of fighting games across our Steam accounts. Or you can sign in with your own Steam account and bring your own game

faq.question: Do I need to bring my own controller?
faq.answer: Preferably. GameHub could provide a Dual Sense, but I wouldn't rely on it. We also have spare controllers at home, so contact us in advance, if you don't have one
